short_description: Non-canonical FirstPersonEmbodiment prototype layered on the accepted CH9.6 character, clothing, Item Graph and ENet presentation stack.
purpose: Evaluate first-person hands, clothing-visible viewmodels, independent left/right grip UX and low-latency item-selection presentation without reopening or mutating the frozen CH9.6 checkpoint and without weakening authority over concrete item actions.
expected_outcome: A separate research lab can render two first-person hands, switch the local active hotbar slot without a durable Item Graph round-trip, project upper clothing into first person, exercise local-only grab targets, and keep concrete item mutations server-authoritative.
current_stage: FPE-R1 Fix8 — zero-stall local hotbar selection validated graphically
progress_note: Operator graphical evidence now confirms the Fix8 hotbar architecture change removes the approximately half-second total SceneTree freeze. With 1..0 selection removed from the durable Item Graph command/checkpoint path, the character continues moving without delay while slots are switched. This closes the severe interactive main-thread stall that remained after Fix6. The validated semantic boundary is: active hotbar slot is CLIENT_LOCAL_PRESENTATION/transient input state, while concrete item actions remain server-authoritative and carry explicit canonical item identity through accepted M7/CH9 command paths. Earlier Fix7 also fixed immediate empty-slot hand clearing. The operator has not yet supplied a clean post-test-double full focused-suite rerun after commit 7012a163, so focused_repository_fix8 remains pending rather than being inferred from graphical success. Equipment drag false-negative handling still needs an operator rerun: CHARACTER_EQUIPMENT_NETWORK_APPLY_FAILED may only be normalized when the server operation succeeded and the already-installed replica proves the requested target relation. Third-person held-item presentation remains deferred.
